name: Herring salad
Code: C5
origin: Rebbetsen Kahane
update: 30/03/92
-------------------------------------------
preparation time:
for 1 big salad bowl

Ingredients:                Special ustensils:

1 box Matias herring
1 red peper
1-2 apples
1 onion

dry bread - soaked and wrung
1-3 tbsp sugar

Preparation:
Grind each ingredient seperately (otherwise while one becomes liquid,
the other is still entire). Mix together. Add sugar to taste.
